title: Saray Mapaabeban Manaanap na Katuaan
intro: Diad dalin ya walaan na pakayari tan panagsalamangka nensaman, walay agawan baleg a panlalaban. Say sakey a dapag et manguusar na autoridad na saray madibinon tanda, bangta say sananey et manasaliw na imposibli. Say pansumpalan et manguman ed andi-anggaan so kurso na awaran. Sarag mo kasin naamtaan so pakabidbiran na saramay akanengneng ed sankatageyan a katuaan tan nampaabeba ed inkasikara ed arap na satan?
clues: Anengneng mi ray tanda ya onlampas ed saray pakana na panagsalamangka
Inmabeba kamin amin, ya agmi nayarian ya iburi so katuaan
Abigbir mi ya sarayan tanda et nanlapud Sakey a Tuan Dios
Sikami so sankaunaan ya komunidad ya angawat na pananisia ed ontan ya makapadinayew a paraan
Insipan ed sikatayo so paraiso bilang tumang ed sisiaen tayo
Saray lubir tan baston mi et nagmaliw ya uleg ed arap na mata mi, balet pinili mi so manpasakop

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say impitongtong ed saray baston nen Propeta Musa
Say bista ed dagem nen Propeta Hud
Say angat manlapud kabatyan a kamelyo nen Propeta Salih
Say baleg a delap so angibaki ed sakey a propeta
Say biahe na sakey a propeta ed loob na sakey a balyena
trial.answer: Say impitongtong ed saray baston nen Propeta Musa

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say ungib na saray kadaanan ya manag-ugip

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Naandi so daakan iran hardin da
Panangiliktar ed sakey a baleg a balyena

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
